content.title: Connecting useful products with the right people
content.intro: Digital marketing uses online channels to help a specific audience discover, understand, and choose a product or service.

sections.title: Start with the audience and goal
body: you want to reach and what useful action you want them to take. A clear goal might be trial signups, event registrations, or completed purchases.

sections.title: Use evidence to improve
sections.body: Marketers choose a message and channel, publish content, then measure what happened. Results such as clicks, signups, and cost help them decide what to improve next.

next.title: Check the marketing foundations
next.body: Choose the audience focused and measurable response in two short situations.

content.title: Check digital marketing foundations
content.intro: Use the audience, goal, and evidence behind each choice.

questions.prompt: Which is the clearest campaign goal?
options: Generate 100 free trial signups this month
questions.explanation: A useful goal names a measurable action, a target, and a time period.

questions.prompt: Why should a marketer review clicks and signups after a campaign?
options: To make the report look longer
To understand what worked and improve the next decision
To avoid learning about the audience
questions.explanation: Campaign evidence helps a marketer keep effective choices and change weaker ones.

completion.title: You understand digital marketing!
completion.body: You learned how audience, goals, messages, channels, and evidence work together.
